decisions.reason: This manual laser marking workstation fits the firm's established laser-marking knowledge and was still listed a year after launch, so early signals support continued learning and refinement rather than withdrawal.

The thermal inkjet printer builds directly on the firm's core coding and marking capabilities and its continued stand-alone presentation suggests it is commercially relevant and within the firm's absorptive capacity to improve.

The piezo inkjet printer is closely related to the firm's existing identification technologies, and keeping its own product page across both years indicates enough traction to justify ongoing development.
As a 2024 flagship shown on the home page, these industrial laser marking systems are central to the firm's Industry 4.0 direction and highly compatible with its deep internal knowledge base.
The compact laser marking cabin is a close adjaceny to the firm's laser portfolio and recent dedicated launch communication points to active commercialization rather than an early exit.

Although more specialized, the lubricant printing system leverages the firm's printing know-how and the trade-fair award provides a strong external validation that supports further exploitation instead of dropping it.
